Container.Name: pascha
Container.Overview:
Copies the photos and videos your daycare posts on Famly into Immich, with dates and captions written into the files. pascha keeps no state and needs no volume: Immich is the record of what has been uploaded, so re-runs skip what is already there.
The container runs one fetch and exits. Schedule re-runs with the User Scripts plugin (a script running "docker start pascha" on a cron such as 0 */6 * * *); see unraid/README.md in the project repository.
Post Arguments take the fetch flags, e.g. "fetch --max-pages 0" for a full backfill on the first run, or "fetch --source tagged" for only images tagged with your children.
Container.Requirement: A running Immich server and an Immich API key with asset upload permission.

Config.Name: Famly email
Config.Description: Email address of your Famly parent login.

Config.Name: Famly password
Config.Description: Password of your Famly parent login.

Config.Name: Immich API URL
Config.Description: Immich API root, ending in /api. For Immich on this server use http://[UNRAID-IP]:[IMMICH-PORT]/api.

Config.Name: Immich API key
Config.Description: Create one in Immich under Account Settings, API Keys.

Config.Name: Famly device ID
Config.Description: Optional but recommended: a fixed UUID (e.g. from 'cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid'), so Famly sees the same device when the container is recreated.

Config.Name: Fallback time zone
Config.Description: IANA zone (e.g. Europe/London) for videos in posts with no zoned image. Empty uses the server's time zone.

Config.Name: Log format
Config.Description: text (readable in the Unraid log viewer) or json.
